name: What Is Time Blocking?
instructions: Time blocking means assigning every task a specific slot on your calendar, rather than working from an open-ended list.
Start today by blocking just tomorrow morning -- one deep work block, and time for your most important task.
Anything not on the calendar tends to lose out to whatever feels most urgent in the moment -- that is the core problem time blocking solves.
Watch today's video for the full beginner's guide to time blocking.
